provenance: A DRY RUN OF THE PROMPT, NOT AN API MEASUREMENT. Produced by applying server/prompts/policy-v1.mjs to policy.txt by hand while building phase 5, because this container has no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. It exists so the pipeline — normalisation, quote verification, assembly, schema — can be exercised against a real document and a realistic answer, including its mistakes. It must not be read as evidence of what the model returns. `npm run verify:policies -- --live` is that measurement.

mentions.subject: identity_controller
mentions.quote: GOV.UK (or www.gov.uk) is provided by the Government Digital Service (GDS), part of the Department for Science, Innovation & Technology (DSIT).

mentions.subject: contact_dpo
mentions.quote: You can also contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO):
mentions.note: The postal address and dataprotection@dsit.gov.uk follow.

mentions.subject: data_categories
mentions.quote: your Internet Protocol (IP) address, and details of which version of web browser you used

mentions.subject: purposes
mentions.quote: gather feedback to improve our services, for example our email alerts

mentions.subject: legal_bases
mentions.quote: The legal basis for processing data collected with Google Analytics and SpeedCurve RUM on GOV.UK and other government digital services is your consent.

mentions.subject: legitimate_interests
mentions.quote: The legal basis for processing personal data in relation to site security is our legitimate interests, and the legitimate interests of our users, in ensuring the security and integrity of GOV.UK.

mentions.subject: recipients
mentions.quote: The data we collect may be shared with other government departments, agencies and organisations.
mentions.note: Categories rather than named recipients, which art. 13(1)(e) allows.

mentions.subject: third_country_transfers
mentions.quote: Where data processing happens in the US, suppliers need to meet the certification standards set out in the UK-US data bridge agreement.

mentions.subject: retention
mentions.quote: delete access log data which contain your IP address after 120 days

mentions.subject: rights_access_rectify_erase
mentions.quote: request that your personal data is erased if there is no longer a justification for it

mentions.subject: right_withdraw_consent
mentions.note: Consent is named as the basis for analytics, but the notice does not state a right to withdraw it.

mentions.subject: right_complain_supervisory
mentions.quote: You can also make a complaint to the Information Commissioner, who is an independent regulator.

mentions.subject: cookies_described
mentions.quote: Find out more about how we use Google Analytics and other cookies on GOV.UK.
mentions.note: The cookies themselves are listed on a separate page this notice only links to.

mentions.subject: consent_withdrawal_mechanism
mentions.note: No control or link for changing the cookie choice is described in this document.
